guide: RankList(title, items, subtitle?, confirmLabel?) — a short list (3-7 strings) the user drags into priority order. Use it to let the user rank or prioritise before you plan. Event: use_order {items} with the items in the user's order (plan from that). Example: card = RankList("Your priorities", ["Design review", "Client feedback session", "Project kickoff", "Workout"])

items.description: The things to rank, in the proposed order.

subtitle.description: Line under the title. Defaults to "Top of the list gets the best hours."

confirmLabel.description: Primary button text. Defaults to "Use this order".
